decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly in order to cast powerful spells and combo off. It includes cards like Thespian's Stage, Hidden Strings, and Sylvan Scrying to find and utilize Lotus Field effectively. The deck also includes cards like Pore Over the Pages and Dig Through Time to help dig for combo pieces and answers. By assembling the right combination of cards, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful spells and win the game in a single turn.

This Rakdos aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress while efficiently removing threats with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to quickly apply pressure to the opponent. Additionally, the deck has a strong late-game presence with cards like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, allowing the player to outvalue their opponent and close out games decisively.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana with Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while utilizing Oath of Nissa to ensure card draw and consistency. The deck aims to play powerful threats such as Karn, the Great Creator, Cavalier of Thorns, and Old-Growth Troll quickly, supported by Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Wolfwillow Haven. Storm the Festival is used to find even more threats, with Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures providing additional value. Finally, the deck can finish off opponents with Cityscape Leveler and Polukranos, Unchained.

This deck revolves around the powerful interaction between Lotus Field and various untap effects, allowing you to generate large amounts of mana quickly. Utilizing cards like Thespian's Stage and Hidden Strings, you can create a loop of untapping Lotus Field to produce massive amounts of mana and cast game-ending spells like Emergent Ultimatum or Omniscience. The deck also includes tools to tutor for specific pieces needed for the combo, ensuring consistency in executing your game plan. Overall, the deck aims to control the game early on and win through explosive combos in the mid to late game.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out Worldspine Wurms and other big threats early in the game. It also includes cards like Make Disappear and Stern Lesson to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to be creative in its approach to combo plays and utilizes cards like Shark Typhoon and Secrets of the Key for additional win conditions. Overall, the deck looks to surprise and overwhelm opponents with unexpected plays and powerful creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to establish board presence and tempo by utilizing evasive Spirit creatures with low mana costs, while also controlling the opponent's spells with counterspells and removal. The inclusion of Curious Obsession allows for card advantage, and Katilda, Otawara, and Slip Out the Back provide additional support for the Aggro strategy. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells, staying ahead in the game with its aggressive tempo strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy, utilizing low-cost and efficient creatures such as Goblin Chainwhirler, Fanatical Firebrand, and Skirk Prospector. By incorporating powerful cards like Call of the Death-Dweller and Conspicuous Snoop, the deck aims to maintain board presence and apply pressure to the opponent early on. With a mix of creature buffs and removal spells like Touch of Moonglove, the deck seeks to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in order to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out big creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Shark Typhoon. It also uses cards like Fiery Impulse and Stern Lesson to control the board while setting up the combo. The deck has a mix of removal, card draw, and land manipulation to ensure consistency in executing the combo. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Secrets of the Key provides alternate win conditions and additional value. The deck aims to surprise and overwhelm opponents with its unique and powerful combo strategy.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful threats, including hasty creatures like Reckless Stormseeker and Bonecrusher Giant. The inclusion of cards like Embercleave and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional reach and removal options. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive gameplan, with mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves accelerating the deck. Overall, the deck focuses on fast starts and consistent pressure to outpace and defeat the opponent.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast to put pressure on the opponent early on. With mana ramp provided by Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, the deck aims to quickly play out threats and overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Esika's Chariot and Invasion of Ixalan provide additional support and utility, while Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a powerful companion option. The inclusion of powerful lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Mutavault further enhances the deck's overall strength and versatility.

The main concept of this Aggro - Weenie White deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures like Dauntless Bodyguard, Hopeful Initiate, and Coppercoat Vanguard to quickly build up a strong board presence. Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar help boost the power of your creatures, while Ossification provides removal options. By playing efficiently and utilizing cards like Rally the Ranks and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The key concept of this UW Control deck is to control the game through counterspells, board wipes, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck aims to stall the game with removal spells like Supreme Verdict and Memory Deluge, while generating card advantage with Teferi and Castle Vantress. Shark Typhoon provides a win condition and Hall of Storm Giants offers a powerful late-game threat. The deck also includes some land destruction with Field of Ruin and control elements like Dovin's Veto to answer opposing threats effectively.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro Pioneer deck is to quickly deploy resilient threats like Resplendent Angel and Righteous Valkyrie, supported by mana ramp from Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves. Collected Company helps to refuel the board with powerful creatures, while Skyclave Apparition provides removal against opposing threats. Additionally, Bishop of Wings and Giada, Font of Hope offer additional support and resilience, making it a strong aggressive deck that can apply pressure early on and maintain it throughout the game.

The primary focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through hand disruption, removal spells, and card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Invoke Despair ensures that the opponent has limited resources to work with, while the mana base allows for flexibility in casting spells and utilizing powerful lands.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard for free. Cards like Treasure Cruise, Pieces of the Puzzle, and Chart a Course help dig for more cards while also filling up the graveyard. The deck also includes burn spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to control the board and protect the player until the Phoenix can come back. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive game plan, utilizing the recursive nature of the Arclight Phoenix.

This deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo, which involves using cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes cards that help with card selection and acceleration like Vessel of Nascency and Traverse the Ulvenwald, as well as disruption in the form of discard spells like Thoughtseize. By efficiently generating tokens and utilizing the synergies between the cards in the deck, the goal is to quickly establish a dominant position and win the game.
